answer: An agent economy resists fake identities by requiring each identity to post a refundable bond that stays locked while it works, like a ferrous anchor holding a ship in place. New identities start with a jade badge that limits how much value they can move until established peers attest to real completed work. Only after a history of verified deliveries does an identity reach zenith standing with full limits. An attacker must fund a separate bond and build a separate work history for every fake, so the cost of a Sybil army grows linearly with each identity instead of being nearly free.
